name: Budget Enforcement & Real Cost Control Validation
objectives: Validate budget hard-stop pauses agents/projects/companies correctly when spend exceeds limit
Validate getInvocationBlock() preflight check blocks agent execution at all entry points
Validate soft warning triggers at configurable threshold (default 80%)
Validate budget incidents create proper approval records with correct approval type
Validate raise_budget_and_resume resolution action correctly restores paused scopes
Validate dismiss resolution action keeps scope paused without clearing incident
Validate subscription-included usage does not trigger money-budget enforcement
Validate incident deduplication within the same budget window
Validate multi-scope hierarchy enforcement (company → agent → project)
Validate cost event → budget evaluation → incident → pause cascade works end-to-end
